tickets.title: Prepare care-cost runway projection comparing aide schedules
tickets.text: Prepare a care-cost runway projection for Helena and Martin Cloudpuddle comparing the current Pocket Lantern Home Care aide schedule with a higher-coverage scenario, showing when cash reserves at Teacup Comet Bank would require increased withdrawals from the Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account.
tickets.evidence: Helena asked for a care-cost runway projection comparing the current aide schedule with a higher-coverage scenario and showing when cash reserves would require an increased taxable-account withdrawal; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-05.

tickets.title: Document family caregiver reimbursement approach for Lila Cloudpuddle
tickets.text: Document a family caregiver reimbursement approach for Lila Cloudpuddle that distinguishes reimbursement from gifts, wages, and shared household costs as she reduces clinic hours to provide weekday transportation and medication supervision for Martin Cloudpuddle.
tickets.evidence: Lila is reducing her clinic hours to cover weekday transportation and medication supervision, and Helena wants a documented family caregiver reimbursement approach that does not blur gifts, wages, and shared household costs; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-12.

tickets.title: Obtain long-term care policy contract and claim packet from Amber Teapot Life Insurance

tickets.evidence: For long-term care claim file materials, Helena had the premium notice but not the full policy contract, claim packet, or elimination-period instructions requested by Amber Teapot Life Insurance; those materials are needed by 2024-01-10.
